top_signals.title: Pimco’s Balls Points to Low Volatility in ‘Healthy’ Bond Market
top_signals.summary: Andrew Balls, global fixed income CIO at Pimco, says it is “not 100% clear to me why” the US Treasury would increase the purchases of long-dated bonds as he explains the factors he finds healthy about the fixed income market. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Japan port call by a nuclear-armed ship would help deter China: ex-official
top_signals.summary: Tokyo should revise the principle of not permitting the entry of nuclear weapons into Japan, ex-Assistant Chief Cabinet Secretary Nobukatsu Kanehara has said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
